name: Rankou Matsuri! 2-nenme!
source:
Each year an orgy party called the "Chigiri Matsuri" (Bedsharing Festival) in the town where I live is celebrated. I participated last year having no idea. The time has come again... to cum again!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ074739.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我住的小镇每年都会举办一场名为“Chigiri Matsuri”（同寝祭）的群交派对。去年我在毫不知情的情况下参加了。如今又到时候了……又要再射一次！

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ074739.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
